name: Carmen Morin
headline: #1 LinkedIn Education Creator 🇨🇦 | Performance-Based Learning & Human-Centered Systems | Fractional CLO | 7-Figure Ed Founder | Concert Pianist | Designing Performance-Based training systems for Business Growth
bio:
Hi, I’m Carmen Morin: Entrepreneur, Educator, and Learning Design Strategist.

I help industry leaders transform their expertise into high-quality, performance-driven training systems that develop top talent and drive scalable revenue. My work spans full-service training catalogue development, executive consulting, and corporate learning strategy.

My journey began not in business, but in high-performance environments, as an internationally awarded concert pianist. After making my orchestral debut at age 10 and touring for the Canadian Embassy, I won first prize in international competition and was later inducted into the Steinway & Sons International Teacher Hall of Fame in New York. These experiences shaped my understanding of discipline, precision, and mastery, principles I now apply to business success.

In 2013, I founded and scaled my music school into a multiple seven-figure enterprise, serving 1,200+ students locally and thousands more globally with a team of 45+ faculty and staff. After building a leadership team and stepping out of daily operations, I expanded my focus to consulting and learning design, helping industry leaders codify their expertise into structured, scalable training programs.

How I Help Organizations & Industry Leaders:

✔ Transform expertise into structured, scalable training systems
✔ Build signature frameworks that establish thought leadership
✔ Design performance-based learning systems that drive measurable outcomes
✔ Develop sustainable education assets that appreciate over time

Ways to Work With Me:

📌 Corporate Learning & Development: Custom training solutions that enhance performance and align with business goals.

📌 Full-Service Program Development: End-to-end development of high-quality programs and training catalogues, codifying expertise into structured, scalable systems.

What Clients Say:

🔹 “Implementing Carmen’s program has been transformational for our team. By focusing the training on performance-based skill-building and behavioural change, our agents graduate with the necessary toolkit to be as successful as they wish to be.”
— Neil Stopher, Director of Sales and Talent Development

🔹 “Carmen helped me enormously launching the Speak Like a CEO Academy, my first scalable, digital offer. She transformed my understanding of how to design and market our offer in just a few sessions.”
— Oliver Aust, CEO

🔹 “Carmen helped me transform my thirty years of clinical counselling expertise, taking it to new heights.”
— Dr. Michael Haggstrom, CEO

Cheering on your success,
Carmen Morin
